one_line: A heavy worker-placement and tableau-building game where leaders of four rival Paths use Exosuits and time travel to prepare for an asteroid impact and become the new seat of the World Capital.
A heavy Viking worker-placement game where you puzzle polyomino goods onto your home board while hunting, raiding, exploring and feeding a feast each round.

A heavy Alexander Pfister cattle-driving Eurogame where you build a deck of cows, hire workers, build along the trail and deliver herds by rail to Kansas City and beyond (2nd edition adds solo rules).
Farming worker-placement classic: build your farm, feed your family, and out-develop rivals over 14 rounds.
Giant GM-less cooperative dungeon-crawl campaign (first edition; Cephalofair now sells a revised Gloomhaven Second Edition at $199.99).
